ui_already_paid: Payment for this flight was already received.
obj_taxi: Taxi along the yellow line to the marker
obj_enter: Enter the runway, turn right and line up
obj_climb: Climb and fly through the markers
obj_final: Final approach: follow the runway lights
advice_wait_rotate: Wait for {v} kt before pulling back
advice_stall: Stall! Lower the nose and add throttle
advice_turn_to_marker: Turn toward the marker — follow the arrow
advice_too_high: Too high — reduce throttle and lower the nose
advice_too_low: Too low — add throttle and raise the nose slightly
advice_too_fast: Too fast — reduce throttle, hold brake as a speedbrake
advice_papi: Two white and two red lights = on the glide path
advice_hold_missed: You rolled past the hold line — always stop before a runway
fadv_crash_obstacle: Stay on the paved taxiway and watch your wingtips.
fadv_hard_landing: Raise the nose slightly just before touchdown and keep sink under 600 ft/min.
fadv_nose_first: Keep the nose slightly up at touchdown.
fadv_offrunway: Line up early with the runway lights and follow the centerline.
fadv_terrain: Watch your altitude and follow the markers.
fail_overrun: Ran off the end of the runway
fadv_overrun: Touch down earlier and hold the brake until you stop.
fadv_missed: Start descending at the final marker and follow the glide path lights.
fadv_lost: Follow the arrow to the next marker.
up_thrust_kit_desc: Upgraded engines: stronger takeoff, faster climb, quicker response.
ct_cmn_rak_brief: First flight: 96 passengers to the Red City.
ct_cmn_fez_brief: Business shuttle to Fès with a turn-back departure.
help_keys: W/S pitch · A/D roll & steer · Shift/Ctrl throttle · Space brake · C camera · G guidance · Esc pause
